name: NiceVois Agent API
description: A focused REST and MCP API for agents. Four free audio tools need no account: split a song into vocals and instrumental, split lead from backing vocals, remove background noise, and remove reverb. With an account, agents train private portable RVC v2 voices or convert vocals with a private NiceVois-trained or uploaded model; conversion returns normal RVC and NiceVois cleaned audio.
